scientific_integrity: Every a(n) needed for the first-zero assertion is recomputed with exact integer numerator/denominator products; strict monotonicity in the window length certifies each least crossing. No floating-point threshold comparison is used.
scientific_limitations: This is a finite exact answer to the zero-existence subquestion for Zelinsky's second difference. It does not address infinitude or the full value set of f or f_alpha.
title: The first zero of Zelinsky's prime-window second difference occurs at \(n=43\)
